title: Verb Tenses - Present and Past
description: Lær dei viktigaste engelske tidene: present simple, present continuous, past simple og past continuous.
competenceGoals: bruke sentrale mønstre for uttale, ordforråd og setningsoppbygging

content.content:
## Verb-tider (Verb Tenses)

Verb-tider fortel oss **når** noko skjer. Engelsk har mange tider, men i dette kapittelet fokuserer vi på dei fire viktigaste: present simple, present continuous, past simple og past continuous.

Å velje rett tid er ei av dei vanlegaste utfordringane for norske elevar.

content.title: Present Simple (enkel presens)
content.content:
Bruk **present simple** for:
- **Fakta og generelle sanningar**: *"Water boils at 100 degrees."*
- **Vanar og rutinar**: *"I wake up at 7 every day."*
- **Faste situasjonar**: *"She lives in Oslo."*

**Bøying**: I/you/we/they + verb | he/she/it + verb + **-s**
- *"I **play** football."* / *"She **plays** football."*
- *"They **go** to school."* / *"He **goes** to school."*

**Nektande**: I/you/we/they + **don't** + verb | he/she/it + **doesn't** + verb
- *"I **don't** like spinach."* / *"She **doesn't** like spinach."*

content.title: Present Continuous (presens kontinuerleg)
content.content:
Bruk **present continuous** for:
- **Handlingar som skjer akkurat no**: *"I am reading a book."*
- **Mellombelse situasjonar**: *"He is staying with friends this week."*
- **Framtidige avtalar**: *"We are meeting tomorrow."*

**Bøying**: am/is/are + verb + **-ing**
- *"I **am watching** TV."*
- *"She **is sleeping**."*
- *"They **are playing** outside."*

content.title: Døme: Present simple vs. present continuous
content.problem:
Kva er skilnaden mellom desse setningane?

a) *"I **read** books."*
b) *"I **am reading** a book."*
content.solution:
a) **Present simple** - dette er ein vane/rutine. Personen les bøker generelt (kanskje som hobby).

b) **Present continuous** - dette skjer akkurat no, i dette augneblinken. Personen sit og les akkurat no.

Enkel hugseregel:
- **Present simple** = noko du gjer regelmessig
- **Present continuous** = noko du gjer akkurat no

exercise.task: Vel rett tid: present simple eller present continuous?

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.solution: "She reads every evening before bed." - present simple for vanar/rutinar.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.solution: "Look! It is raining outside right now." - present continuous for noko som skjer no.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.solution: "Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius." - present simple for fakta/naturlover.

hints: Sjå etter tidsuttrykk: 'every day', 'always' = present simple; 'right now', 'look!' = present continuous.
exercise.solution: Present simple = vanar, fakta, faste situasjonar. Present continuous = noko som skjer no.

content.title: Past Simple (enkel fortid)
content.content:
Bruk **past simple** for:
- **Avslutta handlingar i fortida**: *"I visited Paris last year."*
- **Rekkje av hendingar**: *"She woke up, ate breakfast, and left."*

**Bøying**:
- **Regelrette verb**: verb + **-ed** (*walked, talked, played*)
- **Uregelrette verb**: eiga form (*went, saw, ate, took*)

**Nektande**: subjekt + **didn't** + grunnform
- *"I **didn't go** to the party."* (ikkje: I didn't went)

**Viktige uregelrette verb i fortid:**

| Grunnform | Fortid | Norsk |
|---|---|---|
| go | went | gå |
| see | saw | sjå |
| take | took | ta |
| eat | ate | ete |
| write | wrote | skrive |
| give | gave | gi |
| come | came | komme |
| make | made | lage |
| think | thought | tenkje |
| buy | bought | kjøpe |
| say | said | seie |
| get | got | få |

content.title: Past Continuous (fortid kontinuerleg)
content.content:
Bruk **past continuous** for:
- **Handlingar som pågjekk over tid i fortida**: *"I was reading when the phone rang."*
- **Bakgrunn i forteljingar**: *"The sun was shining and the birds were singing."*

**Bøying**: was/were + verb + **-ing**
- *"I/he/she/it **was** playing."*
- *"You/we/they **were** playing."*

Ofte brukt saman med past simple: **past continuous** (bakgrunn) + **past simple** (handling):
- *"I **was watching** TV when my friend **called**."*

content.title: Døme: Past simple vs. past continuous
content.problem:
Forklar skilnaden:

a) *"When she arrived, I **made** dinner."*
b) *"When she arrived, I **was making** dinner."*
content.solution:
a) **Past simple + past simple**: Handlingane skjedde etter kvarandre. Først kom ho, deretter byrja eg å lage middag.

b) **Past continuous + past simple**: Eg heldt allereie på å lage middag då ho kom. Middagslaginga var bakgrunnen, ankomsten var hendinga.

Past continuous = den pågåande handlinga (bakgrunnen)
Past simple = den plutselege hendinga

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.solution: "Yesterday, we went to the cinema." - past simple for avslutta handling i fortida.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.solution: "I was sleeping when the alarm rang." - past continuous for pågåande handling, past simple for den plutselege hendinga.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.solution: "She didn't come to school last Monday." - nektande past simple med didn't + grunnform.

hints: Etter didn't bruker vi alltid grunnforma av verbet.
Past continuous (was/were + -ing) blir brukt for pågåande bakgrunnshandlingar.
exercise.solution: Past simple = avslutta handlingar. Past continuous = pågåande handlingar i bakgrunnen.

content.content:
**Signalord hjelper deg å velje rett tid:**

| Tid | Signalord |
|---|---|
| Present simple | every day, always, usually, never, often |
| Present continuous | now, right now, at the moment, look! |
| Past simple | yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago |
| Past continuous | while, when, as |

exercise.task: Vel rett tid for kvar setning.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.solution: "Right now, I am writing my homework." - present continuous for noko som skjer no.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.solution: "She plays tennis every Saturday." - present simple for vanar/rutinar.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.solution: "While I was walking home, I found a wallet." - past continuous for bakgrunn, past simple for hending.

exercise.solution: Bruk signalorda til å avgjere kva tid som passar.

exercise.task: Skriv ei kort forteljing (4-6 setningar) om noko du gjorde i helga. Bruk både past simple og past continuous.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: Skriv forteljinga di på engelsk. Bruk past simple for hendingane og past continuous for bakgrunnen.
subTasks.solution: Eksempel: "Last Saturday, I was walking in the park when I saw my friend. She was sitting on a bench and reading a book. I went over and said hello. We talked for an hour, and then we went to a cafe. It was a great day."

hints: Start med å setje scena (past continuous): The sun was shining, I was walking...
Bruk past simple for hendingane: I saw, we went, she said...
exercise.solution: Å kombinere past simple og past continuous gjer forteljingar meir levande og detaljerte.

exercise.task: Kva er fortidsforma av desse uregelrette verba?
exercise.solution: Uregelrette verb har eigne fortidsformer som du må lære utanåt.

content.content:
## Oppsummering

| Tid | Bruk | Eksempel |
|---|---|---|
| Present simple | Vanar, fakta | *She plays tennis.* |
| Present continuous | Skjer no | *She is playing tennis.* |
| Past simple | Avslutta fortid | *She played tennis yesterday.* |
| Past continuous | Pågåande fortid | *She was playing when I called.* |

**Hugseregelen for fortid:**
- **Past simple** = hendinga (kva skjedde)
- **Past continuous** = bakgrunnen (kva pågjekk)

Øv på uregelrette verb - dei er nøkkelen til å snakke og skrive korrekt om fortida!
